protein_name: Spore wall and anchoring disk complex protein EnP1
label: adhesin
assay_summary: Recombinant EnP1 and anti-EnP1 antibody each inhibited Encephalitozoon spore adherence to host cells and reduced infection, deletion of the N-terminal heparin-binding motif ablated that inhibition, and EnP1 bound host cells but not cells lacking surface glycosaminoglycans.
notes: UniProt entry is reviewed, names the protein "Host cell adhesion protein EnP1" and cites PMID 17557882; gene ECU01_0820 matches the accession given in the paper abstract. Binds host GAGs via heparin-binding motifs (lectin-type, not a classical sugar-binding fold). Also used as the positive control in PMID 20811483.

protein_name: Spore wall and anchoring disk complex protein EnP1
label: adhesin
assay_summary: Same study characterised the E. intestinalis EnP1 orthologue, where recombinant protein and antibody inhibited spore adherence to and infection of host cells and binding required host cell surface glycosaminoglycans.
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry, alternative name "Host cell adhesion protein EnP1", sole literature reference is PMID 17557882. Second species of the same paper; 30% homologue of Q8SWL3, so the two are not independent clusters.

label: adhesin
assay_summary: Recombinant SWP26 inhibited N. bombycis spore adherence to host cells by ~10% and lowered infection while an HBM-deleted mutant did not, and the same C-terminal heparin-binding motif was shown to mediate direct binding to the host IgSF receptor Bmtutl-519 (abolished by K208G/K209G/K210G/K213G).
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry SWP26_NOSB1 cites PMID 18854188. Host partner first found by co-IP/Y2H in PMID 23542093 (BmTLP), mapped to the HBM in PMID 30528488. Homologous system in shrimp (EhSWP1/LvTLP) is a separate row.

label: adhesin
assay_summary: Pre-treatment with recombinant SWP9-GST or with anti-SWP9 antibody each significantly decreased N. bombycis spore adhesion to and infection of BmN host cells; SWP9 also binds deproteinated chitin spore coats and is required to recruit SWP7 to the wall.
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry SWP9_NOSB1 cites PMID 25605761. Its partner SWP7 (B3STP1) is ALREADY PRESENT in existing.tsv as an E1 adhesin from the same paper, so SWP9 and SWP7 are one experimental unit, not two.

label: adhesin
assay_summary: Native NbHSWP11 from soluble mature-spore protein bound the surface of BmE host cells in a host-cell binding assay, and purified anti-NbHSWP11 antibody blocked spore adherence, lowering the adherence rate by ~20% versus untreated spores.
notes: CONFIRMED on the second pass, no longer an inference. The GenBank flatfile for ABV48899.1 carries /gene="HSWP11" on its CDS feature (coded_by EF683111.1), and Table 1 of the open-access review PMID 32132983 (PMC7040029) independently lists NbSWP11 as 52.3 kDa, 446 aa, DnaJ domain, GenBank EF683111, Yang et al. 2014 - i.e. PMID 24813020. No UniProt entry exists. Record verified live by efetch: 446 aa, Nosema bombycis, djlA/DnaJ co-chaperone regions at 309-357 and 336-442, consistent with the paper's DnaJ-domain protein carrying 6 heparin-binding motifs.

label: adhesin
assay_summary: Recombinant EhPTP4 bound mammalian host cells by IFA, ELISA and FACS, co-immunoprecipitated host transferrin receptor 1 (identified by MS), and adding rPTP4, anti-PTP4 antibody, soluble TfR1 or knocking out TfR1 each significantly reduced E. hellem infection.
notes: No UniProt entry; locus EHEL_071080 given in the paper resolves by eutils esummary to XP_003887615.1 (278 aa, Encephalitozoon hellem ATCC 50504). Polar tube tip protein rather than a wall protein, so topologically unlike the other rows.

label: adhesin
assay_summary: Purified EhSWP1 bound heparin in an in vitro binding and competition assay that was lost when its heparin-binding motifs were mutated, and recombinant EhSWP1 bound the shrimp host receptor turtle-like protein (LvTLP) by co-immunoprecipitation and ELISA with KD 1.2e-7 M.
notes: UniProt A0A2R3U967 (gene SWP1, Ecytonucleospora hepatopenaei) cites PMID 29530076, the paper that identified and named EhSWP1. The LvTLP binding and RNAi data are PMID 37506856. Same HBM/BAR2 architecture as NbSWP26, so treat the two as one family.

label: hard_negative
assay_summary: NbSWP12 was isolated from germinated spore coats and shown to bind deproteinated N. bombycis chitin spore coats, supporting a structural spore-wall maintenance role; no host-cell adherence activity was demonstrated for it.
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry SWP12_NOSB1, gene synonym HSWP12 matching the paper's NbHSWP12. HARD CASE: SWP9 (an adhesin row above) also binds chitin coats, so chitin binding alone does not separate positives from negatives here.

label: hard_negative
assay_summary: SWP5 co-immunoprecipitated the polar tube proteins PTP2 and PTP3 and anti-SWP5 serum pre-treatment of mature spores significantly decreased polar tube extrusion, indicating a structural wall/polar-tube role; no effect on host cell adherence was shown.
notes: TrEMBL entry, submission name "Spore wall protein 5", reference title "SWP5, a novel spore wall protein interaction with PTP2 in Microsporidian Nosema bombycis" matches PMID 22140229; 186 aa agrees with the reported 20.3 kDa. In PMID 25363531 anti-NbSWP5 added to anti-NbSWP16 gave no further adherence inhibition.

organism: Rhizopus delemar (strain RA 99-880 / ATCC MYA-4621 / FGSC 9543 / NRRL 43880)
label: hard_negative
assay_summary: rFTR1 restored iron-limited growth and radiolabelled iron uptake to an S. cerevisiae ftr1 null, and RNAi knockdown plus reduced FTR1 copy number compromised R. delemar iron acquisition in vitro and attenuated virulence in diabetic ketoacidotic mice, with no adhesion phenotype measured.
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry FTR1_RHIO9 cites both PMIDs. Surface-exposed (anti-Ftr1p passive immunisation protects mice) Mucorales membrane protein whose shown function is transport, so a clean hard negative against the CotH adhesins of the same organism.

organism: Rhizopus delemar (strain RA 99-880 / ATCC MYA-4621 / FGSC 9543 / NRRL 43880)
label: hard_negative
assay_summary: RNA interference against mucoricin reduced R. delemar damage to host cells and virulence in mice, and the purified 17 kDa protein inhibited protein synthesis via N-glycosylase activity and caused vascular permeability that anti-toxin and anti-ricin-B antibodies blocked; the demonstrated function is toxicity, not adhesion.
notes: Reviewed UniProt entry RLT1_RHIO9 cites PMID 33462434. Deliberately chosen hard negative: it carries a ricin-B lectin sequence, the same domain family that makes the microsporidian RBL-like proteins adhesin candidates, yet its measured function is ribosome inactivation. Secreted/hyphal rather than wall-anchored.

protein_name: Lectin-like protein CBM18-LL1 (carbohydrate-binding module family 18 protein)
label: hard_negative
assay_summary: In vitro binding assays of the full-length protein and of single CBM18 domains showed binding to chitin and no binding to cellulose or xylan, a GFP fusion was trafficked to the cell boundary and co-localised with calcofluor-stained chitin, and the expressed CBM18 domains protected Trichoderma reesei from hydrolysis by exogenously added chitinase.
notes: ADHESION WAS NEVER ASSAYED for this protein: the demonstrated function is self-protection of the fungus' own chitin, so it is a hard negative, not a failed adhesin. Accession chain: UniProt A0A097F7X9, gene name CBM18-LL1, 465 aa, from EMBL KM099424 / AIT18659.1, whose GenBank record reads "Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis strain JEL423 lectin-like protein (CBM18-LL1) mRNA", note "carbohydrate-binding module family 18 protein", authors Stajich,J.E. and Liu,P., deposited 2014-07-02 under the pre-publication title of PMID 25819009, which names CBM18-LL1 in its abstract. Only CBM18-LL1 was ever deposited; CBM18-LL2 and the tyrosinase-/deacetylase-like members have no retrievable accession. THE ONLY CHYTRIDIOMYCOTA ROW in the set.

protein_name: Spore wall protein 16 (NbSWP16; annotated as spore wall and anchoring disk complex protein, NBO_29g0021)
label: adhesin
assay_summary: Pre-treatment with anti-NbSWP16 antibody decreased N. bombycis spore adherence to host cells by more than 20% relative to the negative control, while adding anti-NbSWP5 alongside anti-NbSWP16 gave no further reduction.
notes: Accession recovered on the second pass from Table 1 of the open-access review PMID 32132983 (PMC7040029), which lists NbSWP16 as 44.0 kDa, GenBank EOB14338, Wang et al. 2015. Verified live: EOB14338.1 = UniProt R0MN98, 383 aa, Nosema bombycis CQ1. Sequence independently matches every feature the primary paper reports - N-terminal signal peptide, basic heparin-binding stretches, and exactly three tandem copies of the proline-rich repeat EPPHHHPKPCPPC (10.2% Pro) - and 383 aa agrees with the reported 44 kDa. The review's own "221 aa" column entry is inconsistent with its own 44.0 kDa and is a typo. Mechanism called lectin from the three HBMs by analogy with SWP26/EnP1; the HBMs were NOT shown to mediate the blocking.

label: hard_negative
assay_summary: RNAi knockdown of AlocSWP2 in infected locusts significantly lowered the spore burden and significantly raised host survival on days 15-17 post-inoculation, and immunocytochemistry placed the protein in the wall of meronts, sporonts, sporoblasts and mature spores, giving it a demonstrated role in sporulation.
notes: UniProt Q6E6F1 (gene SWP2, 222 aa) cross-references EMBL KX255658, whose GenBank record is "Antonospora locustae spore wall protein (SWP2) mRNA" with /note="AlocSWP2", protein_id API85832.1, authors Chen,L. and Zhang,L. - the authors of PMID 28277606. Table 1 of PMID 32132983 independently lists AlocSWP2 as 25.0 kDa, 222 aa, KX255658. VALUABLE HARD NEGATIVE: it carries both a GPI anchor signal and a heparin-binding motif, the same HBM feature that marks the adhesin positives in this set, yet its measured function is sporulation and no adherence assay was done.
